## Data Analytics Portfolio

*Transforming data into actionable insights for business decision-making.*

### Experience

Data analytics professional with 5+ years of consulting and project management experience at Accenture, including 2+ years in a managerial role.

My background includes large-scale digital transformation, KPI reporting, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination across international teams. I have worked extensively with Jira, Confluence, Excel, and reporting workflows to support operational visibility and decision-making.

### Technical Focus

My current technical focus includes Python, SQL, Tableau, machine learning, and deep learning, with a growing portfolio of projects that connect business problems with data-driven solutions.

### Portfolio Focus

This portfolio highlights selected work in analytics, NLP, and business-focused problem solving.
